data.current_summary: Returns a web page or PDF as clean Markdown or HTML
data.current_description:
The Extract API fetches a web page or PDF and returns it as clean Markdown, HTML, or both. Use it after a Web Search API call, when your agent needs the full document, such as a filing, a contract, or a research paper, instead of a highlight.

PDF tables come back as Markdown or HTML tables with rows and columns intact. Set `parse_effort=standard` to also send complex PDF pages, such as charts and images, through an advanced model for the most complete output.
data.summary_suggestion: Extract web page or PDF content as Markdown or HTML
data.description_suggestion: Fetches and converts a web page or PDF document into clean, structured Markdown or HTML format. Accepts a URL or PDF source and returns extracted content with preserved formatting, including tables with intact rows and columns. Use after Web Search API calls when full document content is needed (e.g., filings, contracts, research papers). Set `parse_effort=standard` to process complex PDF elements like charts and images through advanced parsing. Returns ExtractResult containing extracted content, metadata, and formatting. Requires valid API key authentication. May return empty ExtractResult if content cannot be extracted.
